title: Leaderboard query: Streak leaderboard
description: Create Convex query to fetch streak leaderboard. Returns users ranked by current streak (consecutive days practiced). Only includes users with displayName set. Supports period filter (weekly/monthly/all-time) and pagination.

acceptanceCriteria.text: getStreakLeaderboard query accepts period, limit, offset args
Query only returns users with displayName set
Users are sorted by currentStreak descending
Returns array with rank, displayName, streak, language fields
